description: This file defines the MetricUtils object in the org.apache.spark.util package, providing utility functions for metric aggregation and string representation in Spark, including handling different metric types like sum, size, timing, and average.

classes.name: MetricUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions for metrics processing in Spark.

methods.name: toNumberFormat
methods.description: Formats a Long value into a string with US locale, dividing by baseForAvgMetric.

methods.name: metricNeedsMax
methods.description: Determines if a metric type requires a maximum value for representation.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Generates a string representation of metric values based on metric type, including sum, average, size, timing, and nsTiming.
